evidence.name: Screen field: Main button text style
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Main button text style" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Main button text style
sections.description: Typography for the main button label — font, weight, size, color, and alignment. Leave it on the theme defaults for a consistent look; bump the weight or size, or switch color, only when the label is hard to read against the button fill. Applies to the label in every language.
